sec12.sec12_text:
Notes:
[1] 10,000-level: smart dimming adjusts brightness in 1% steps and color temperature in 1% steps, giving 10,000 combinations of light.
[2] No wake word: with ORVIBO's ONE STEP technology you don't say a wake word first; just say the command, such as “Turn on the light” or “Turn off the AC”.
[3] Easy control of smart lights, smart curtains, AC, underfloor heating and fresh air: the AC, fresh air system, underfloor heating, smart lights and smart curtains are sold separately.
[4] Stepless adjustment and dimming: traditional lighting control is just on and off, or a few fixed brightness presets. ORVIBO's Mix-Light 10,000-level dimming technology, combined with the knob, gives you silky-smooth dimming.
[5] Still like new after 5 years: in ORVIBO lab reliability tests the product withstood 60,000 presses and its glass still met ORVIBO's quality standards. At 20 switchings a day, that is 5 years of use. Actual results may vary with how it is used.
[6] 4-inch voice control screen: the Gauss voice control screen's panel measures 4.76 inches diagonally, so we call it 4-inch.
[7] 15-year relay life: based on ORVIBO lab tests (LED lamps with a 400 W load: relay life over 60,000 cycles, key life over 100,000 presses; at 10 switchings a day, 16.4 years). Actual results may vary with the materials and workmanship of different lamp brands.
[8] Well above the industry average: the industry average for surge protection is 1 kV.
[9] Prevents short-circuit fires on overload: this product has overload protection. Do not connect lamps or other loads (such as exhaust fans or bathroom heaters) above its rated power, or the product may be permanently damaged.
[10] Imported V0 flame-retardant PC to prevent fire hazards: per the UL94 V-0 standard.
